source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    frame = grid[r0][c0]
    core = [(r, c) for r, c in points if grid[r][c] != frame]
    color = grid[core[0][0]][core[0][1]]
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r, c in core), max(r for r, c in core)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r, c in core), max(c for r, c in core)
    ih, iw = ir1 - ir0 + 1, ic1 - ic0 + 1
    grow = ih if ih == iw else max(1, min(ih, iw) - 1)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0 - grow), min(h, r1 + grow + 1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0 - grow), min(w, c1 + grow + 1)):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''

    return a
